svg.title: Timeline for Josef Pyrć and Zofia Gościńska, including disputed dates and immigration records
svg.desc: Joseph's lifeline is on the left and Sophie's on the right. Hollow markers identify disputed birth and immigration details. Joseph: family birth year 1879 (disputed), possible Josef Pyrc arrival 1905, arrival stated in Sophie's petition as 1911, died 1940. Sophie: citizenship papers give 1883, death certificate gives 1893, a possible 1913 manifest match is uncertain, petition says continuous U.S. residence since May 1912, naturalized 1938, died 1964. Shared: married in Muszyna in 1910; petition-listed children Stanley 1911, Bernice 1914, Charles 1919, Taddeus 1920, Stella 1923; census surname Puirch in 1930; Sophie recorded as Pyrce in 1938.
